---
name: Feature request
about: Propose a new feature or improvement
title: '[Feature] '
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## Problem statement

What problem does this feature solve? Who is affected, and in what scenario?

## Proposed solution

Describe what you would like to see added or changed. Be as specific as possible.

## Serverless check

SophaxChat is **serverless by design** — every feature must work without a central server.

- [ ] This feature works fully peer-to-peer with no server required
- [ ] This feature requires a server (explain why there is no P2P alternative below)

_If a server is involved, explain:_

## Security / privacy impact

Does this feature change the threat model, key material handling, or metadata exposure in any way? If yes, describe the impact.

## Alternatives considered

What other approaches did you consider, and why did you reject them?

## Additional context

Mockups, examples from other apps, related issues, prior art, etc.
